about_us.title: Rescuable, something that can be saved
about_us.description: At Saveabl, we systematically identify waste among producers and wholesalers, and create a ready-made food bag based on what needs to be rescued! Our food bag exists in the magical borderland between a traditional food bag and ready-made takeaway. In addition to the climate issue, we strongly believe in convenience and have therefore developed a food bag that is ready in 15 minutes. Incredibly smooth and incredibly tasty!

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: Here the first idea arose for what would become Saveabl. Jeroen and Alexander wondered if they could make it even easier for customers to save good food from being thrown away. The problem they saw was that it was a little difficult to know what to do with the food that was on Matsmart, there were limited goods, and the guys' solution would be to link one of the new grocery stores' assortment with Matsmart. The customer could easily enter their shopping list and the goods that were on Matsmart, and what was not there, would be supplemented with goods from, for example, Coop's online store! Great thought Jeroen and Alexander! The problem they saw was that it was a little difficult to know what to do.
